block.goal: Extract a cohesive File state holder to reduce the number of fields and related accessors in FileEntry. Move the file attribute fields and their getters/setters/refresh logic into a new FileEntryAttributes class in the same package.

ops.details: Create a new class FileEntryAttributes in package org.apache.commons.io.monitor. The class will encapsulate the following fields: String name; boolean exists; boolean directory; SerializableFileTime lastModified; long length. It will provide the moved accessors and mutators: getName(), setName(String), isExists(), setExists(boolean), isDirectory(), setDirectory(boolean), getLastModified(), getLastModifiedFileTime(), setLastModified(FileTime), setLastModified(long), setLastModified(SerializableFileTime) (package-private or public as needed), getLength(), setLength(long). Move the refresh(File) implementation that reads the File to update these fields and returns a boolean indicating change (use Files.exists(file.toPath()), file.isDirectory(), FileUtils.lastModifiedFileTime(file) and file.length()). The class will import java.io.File, java.io.IOException, java.nio.file.Files, java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime and org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils and org.apache.commons.io.file.attribute.FileTimes and will use SerializableFileTime the same way as FileEntry. Put the new file in the same package (org.apache.commons.io.monitor). Ensure exception handling mirrors the original refresh implementation.
